classification.difficultyReason: Interpret nested unions and intersections and shade the corresponding regions of three overlapping sets.

spec.description: Unshaded rectangular universe containing overlapping circles A upper left, B upper right and C below. Labels occupy exclusive regions.
spec.mathematics: Three sets with all pairwise intersections and a nonempty triple intersection.
spec.answerVisibility: No supplied shading is visible in the student diagram.

answer.short: Shade all of $C$ and the overlap $A\cap B$.
answer.worked: The intersection $A\cap B$ is the region inside both $A$ and $B$. Taking its union with $C$ includes that overlap and every region inside $C$, including the triple intersection.

spec.description: Entire C circle and the A–B intersection shaded in restrained light blue; outlines and labels remain black.

spec.mathematics: Three sets with all pairwise intersections and a nonempty triple intersection.
spec.answerVisibility: No supplied shading is visible in the student diagram.

answer.short: Shade $A\cap B$ and $A\cap C$, including the triple intersection.
answer.worked: The union $B\cup C$ includes everything inside $B$ or $C$. Intersecting it with $A$ keeps only those regions also inside $A$: the overlaps $A\cap B$ and $A\cap C$, including the triple intersection.

spec.description: A–B and A–C intersections shaded in restrained light blue, including their common triple intersection; all other regions unshaded.
